ally or vamp to burn.

Messages.Author: CthuluKitty
Messages.Body:
On Jul 28, 1:58 am, librarian <aucti...@superfuncards.com> wrote:
> Rudolfo Giovanni get's a Fortitude skill card and a Soul Gem.
>
> He recruits a Shambler, and plays Daring the Dawn, thus burning.
> Shambling Horde's text says remove a vamp from the game - does Rudolfo
> qualify?  Or has he not yet burned when Shambling needs to check for the
> ally or vamp to burn.

As the card text explicates, the removal or burning effect occurs
"when Shambling Hordes is put into play", which is during the
resolution of the recruit ally action. The aggravated damage from
Daring the Dawn explicitly occurs "after the action resolves". The
burned Rudolfo will definitely not be in the ash heap for the
Shambling Hordes.

However, this probably would not be a major problem for a deck built
around a silly trick like this. You'll just need to get another minion
into your ash heap before bringing out the first Horde, as usual, but
burned copies of Rudolfo will work for subsequent ones.
